FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something's missing. This kingdom needs a new aesthetic.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER PIPER, approaches the king.

JESTER PIPER
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I'm tired of the same old suits of armor and banners. I want something new, something... futuristic.

JESTER PIPER
Futuristic, Your Majesty? But we're in the Middle Ages!

KING REGINALD
Exactly! That's what I mean. We need to break free from the shackles of tradition.

JESTER PIPER
I see what you mean, Your Majesty. But what exactly do you have in mind?

KING REGINALD
I want to incorporate more... synths. And neon lights. And... and... (he consults a small notebook)... VHS tapes.

JESTER PIPER
(stunned)
VHS tapes, Your Majesty?

KING REGINALD
Yes! We'll hang them from the castle walls, and play them on loop. It'll be like a never-ending video montage of our kingdom's history.

JESTER PIPER
(skeptical)
I'm not sure that's the best idea, Your Majesty.

KING REGINALD
Nonsense! It'll be a game-changer. And I want to start with the aesthetic of our knights. I want them to wear neon-colored armor, and have their helmets shaped like VHS tapes.

JESTER PIPER
(laughing)
You're a genius, Your Majesty!

CUT TO:

INT. CASTLE GREAT HALL - DAY

The king's knights, now clad in neon-colored armor, stand at attention as the king addresses them.

KING REGINALD
Men, I have a new vision for our kingdom. We will be the most... futuristic kingdom in all the land!

KING REGINALD
(to a nearby knight)
And I want you to wear that helmet with the VHS tape design. It's a statement piece.

KING REGINALD
(to another knight)
And I want you to carry that neon-colored lance. It's a symbol of our kingdom's... (he consults his notebook)... "radical chic".

KING REGINALD
(to the entire group)
We will be the envy of all the other kingdoms. We will be the... (he pauses, searching for the right word)... "vaporwave" of the medieval world!

The knights look at each other in confusion, but the king just smiles.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

The VHS tapes are hung from the castle walls, playing a continuous loop of medieval footage. The king and his knights walk along the walls, admiring their new aesthetic.

KING REGINALD
(to Jester Piper)
Isn't it wonderful, Jester? We're truly... (he consults his notebook)... "on the cutting edge" of medieval fashion.

JESTER PIPER
(laughing)
You're a true visionary, Your Majesty.

KING REGINALD
(smiling)
I'm just trying to bring a little... (he pauses, searching for the right word)... "futurism" to our kingdom.

As the camera pans out, we see the entire kingdom, bathed in the glow of neon lights and VHS tapes. It's a truly... (he consults his notebook)... "radical" sight to behold.

FADE TO BLACK.
